bracket_contract.bracketless_definition: a decision is bracketless when its own protection did not form: swing_baseline stamps stop_price == entry_reference only when protection_at returned None
bracket_contract.divergence_class_definition: BRACKET_CONTRACT_DIVERGENCE: the bracket flag handed to replay_bracket differs between the two declared readings of the same campaign — the policy-name reading replays a decision whose own protection never formed in the bracket branch, the decision reading holds it unprotected to its expiry
bracket_contract.note: the per-family bracket_contract block is the authority for that family; this rollup repeats its counts by policy, never as one pooled number
bracket_contract.published_reading_statement: the published return columns are produced under READING_A_POLICY_NAME: a policy that declares a protection is replayed as bracketed for every one of its decisions, which is the contract the predecessor P2 artifact (sha256 41ab7a0da11812818a67ce8f92709be083b1dd79c80ad4a7670d27a163eb32ec) was produced under. READING_B_DECISION_CONTRACT is published beside it with its own counts and its numbers are NOT the published series

reading_basis.basis: has_bracket = the policy name declares a protection (protection_policy not in (None, 'timeout-only-v1'))
has_bracket = the policy declares a protection AND this decision's own protection formed (stop_price != entry_reference)

evidence_class: DECISION_PLANE_DIAGNOSTIC over four years of real bars: real taker fee and real funding settlement rows; not engine fills, not a venue settlement; slippage is a declared assumption and the measured execution shortfall is absent

bracket_contract.bracketless_definition: a decision is bracketless when its own protection did not form: swing_baseline stamps stop_price == entry_reference only when protection_at returned None
bracket_contract.divergence_class_definition: BRACKET_CONTRACT_DIVERGENCE: the bracket flag handed to replay_bracket differs between the two declared readings of the same campaign — the policy-name reading replays a decision whose own protection never formed in the bracket branch, the decision reading holds it unprotected to its expiry
notes: both readings cover the same decisions in the same order; only the bracket flag handed to replay_bracket differs
a campaign whose two readings agree carries counter_reading: null — there is one replay and its counter row IS its published row
the published return columns are the READING_A columns: no threshold, window or bracketing semantic moved with this publication
bracket_contract.published_reading_statement: the published return columns are produced under READING_A_POLICY_NAME: a policy that declares a protection is replayed as bracketed for every one of its decisions, which is the contract the predecessor P2 artifact (sha256 41ab7a0da11812818a67ce8f92709be083b1dd79c80ad4a7670d27a163eb32ec) was produced under. READING_B_DECISION_CONTRACT is published beside it with its own counts and its numbers are NOT the published series

reading_a.basis: has_bracket = the policy name declares a protection (protection_policy not in (None, 'timeout-only-v1'))

reading_b.basis: has_bracket = the policy declares a protection AND this decision's own protection formed (stop_price != entry_reference)

drawdown_basis.unit: percent of that path's own running peak, in return-sum units (not capital percent)

capital_utilization_pct.basis: share of a capital base actually deployed as position size
capital_utilization_pct.reason: no position sizing / no capital basis in this producer: a utilization share cannot be measured from a fee column

cashflow_discrepancy_usdt.basis: the double-entry residual the producer reconciles, passed in as an input

expert_displacement_rate.basis: share of campaigns an expert baseline would have won that the family took
expert_displacement_rate.reason: this producer runs no expert baseline and carries no displaced-expert series, so the rate would be a pass-shaped zero

friction_retention_ratio.unit: fraction of gross return retained after measured fees and funding (signed)

funding_drag_ratio.unit: fraction of gross return paid as funding (saturating at 1.0)

habitat_selectivity_score.basis: campaigns / bars, where bars is the decision frames the tape offered
habitat_selectivity_score.unit: entries per decision frame — how selectively the family fired

max_adverse_excursion_pct.basis: 100 * max(running peak - cumulative campaign net return) over the uncompounded sum of campaign net returns, or, when no path is supplied, the caller's own max_drawdown_pct measurement
max_adverse_excursion_pct.unit: percent of the path's own running peak, in return-sum units

recovery_horizon_bars.basis: tape bars from the trough of the deepest drawdown of the uncompounded campaign-return path to the first point at which that path re-attains the peak it fell from
recovery_horizon_bars.reason: the uncompounded campaign-return path never re-attains the peak it fell from inside the tape, or no per-campaign path was supplied: there is no recovery to measure

regime_stability_score.basis: 1 - scenario_failure_fraction: the share of campaigns not charged to a failure domain, restated as a stability score; a declared derivation, not an independent measurement of regime segmentation

ruin_margin_pct.basis: 100 - max_adverse_excursion_pct: the same drawdown restated as a margin, in the same return-sum units; not an independent measurement and not clamped
ruin_margin_pct.unit: percent of the path's own running peak, in return-sum units

scenario_failure_fraction.unit: fraction of campaigns charged to one of the seven disjoint failure domains

slippage_fragility_score.basis: (measured_net - net_with_modelled_slippage_sum) / abs(measured_net), where measured_net = gross_return_sum - fee_cost_sum - funding_cost_sum
slippage_fragility_score.unit: fraction of the measured net return consumed by the declared slippage model

tail_capture_efficiency.basis: share of the campaign return distribution's tail that the family captured
tail_capture_efficiency.reason: no tail cut is declared over a per-campaign return distribution in this producer, so a tail capture share would be a pass-shaped guess

turnover_efficiency.basis: traded notional over the capital that carried it
turnover_efficiency.reason: this producer holds no traded notional and no capital base (a returns-only decision plane), so turnover would be a pass-shaped guess

robustness_vector_unmeasured.reason: no tail cut is declared over a per-campaign return distribution in this producer, so a tail capture share would be a pass-shaped guess
the uncompounded campaign-return path never re-attains the peak it fell from inside the tape, or no per-campaign path was supplied: there is no recovery to measure
this producer holds no traded notional and no capital base (a returns-only decision plane), so turnover would be a pass-shaped guess
no position sizing / no capital basis in this producer: a utilization share cannot be measured from a fee column
this producer runs no expert baseline and carries no displaced-expert series, so the rate would be a pass-shaped zero
